past-tense.title: Talking About the Past
past-tense.explanation: The simple past is much more regular than the present: for almost every verb, the past stem is just the infinitive with the final ن removed. رفتن (raftan, "to go") -> رفت (raft, "went"); خوردن (khordan, "to eat") -> خورد (khord, "ate"). Personal endings attach directly, and the "he/she/it" form has NO ending at all -- the bare past stem alone already means "he/she/it did."
past-tense.fact: Because the present tense stems are so irregular but the past stems are so regular, many Dari textbooks actually teach the past tense before the present -- it is the easier one to predict.

dialogue.native: من به بازار رفتم و میوه خریدم.
dialogue.en: I went to the market and bought fruit.

plurals-comparatives.title: More Than One, and Comparing Things
plurals-comparatives.explanation: To make almost any Dari noun plural, add ها to the end: کتاب (book) -> کتاب‌ها (books). To compare two things, add تر to an adjective: بزرگ (big) -> بزرگ‌تر (bigger). Adding ترین instead makes the superlative: بزرگ‌ترین (the biggest).
plurals-comparatives.fact: بهتر ("better") and بدتر ("worse") are irregular comparatives, built from به/خوب (good) and بد (bad) -- the same kind of exception English has with "good -> better," not "gooder."

dialogue.native: بلی، این کتاب از آن کتاب بهتر است.
dialogue.en: Yes, this book is better than that book.

items.en: Yesterday I went to the market.
He/She ate bread yesterday.
We saw a movie yesterday.
What did you say yesterday?
They worked yesterday.
I bought a new book yesterday.

items.dari: او دیروز به خانه ما آمد.
items.en: He/She came to our house yesterday.
items.translit: U diroz ba khāna-ye mā āmad.

items.dari: پارسال من به هرات سفر کردم.
items.en: Last year I traveled to Herat.
items.translit: Pārsāl man ba Herāt safar kardam.

items.en: A passport and visa were needed.

items.dari: ما در یک هوتل خوب ماندیم.
items.en: We stayed in a good hotel.
items.translit: Mā dar yak hotel-e khub māndim.

items.en: I had a big suitcase.

items.dari: مسافران زیاد در میدان هوایی بودند.
items.en: There were many travelers at the airport.
items.translit: Musāferān-e ziyād dar meydān-e hawāyi budand.

items.en: This trip was very good.

items.dari: ما دیشب به یک رستورانت رفتیم.
items.en: We went to a restaurant last night.
items.translit: Mā dishab ba yak restorant raftim.

items.en: I wanted kebab and salad.
He/She ate soup.

items.dari: بشقاب و کارد روی میز بود.
items.en: The plate and knife were on the table.
items.translit: Boshqāb wa kārd roy-e meyz bud.

items.en: The food was very delicious.

items.dari: بعد از غذا، ما چای نوشیدیم.
items.en: After the food, we drank tea.
items.translit: Ba'd az ghazā, mā chāy noshidim.

items.en: Yesterday I was sick.
My head hurt.
I had a fever and cough.
I went to the hospital.
The doctor gave medicine.
Now my health is good.

items.dari: چهار فصل داریم: بهار، تابستان، خزان، و زمستان.
items.en: We have four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
items.translit: Chahār fasl dārim: bahār, tābestān, khazān, wa zemestān.

items.en: Summer is hotter than winter.
Winter is colder than summer.
Spring is a beautiful season.

items.dari: کدام فصل را بیشتر دوست دارید؟
items.en: Which season do you like most?
items.translit: Kudām fasl rā bishtar dost dārid?

items.en: Autumn is the best season.

items.dari: دیروز من به شما زنگ زدم.
items.en: Yesterday I called you.
items.translit: Diroz man ba shomā zang zadam.

items.dari: موبایل من در دست من بود.
items.en: My mobile phone was in my hand.
items.translit: Mobāyl-e man dar dast-e man bud.

items.en: He/She sent a message.
I read your message.
Why didn't you call?
My phone didn't work.
Go straight.
Then go right.
My house is near the square.

items.dari: از این گوشه به چپ بروید.
items.en: Go left from this corner.
items.translit: Az in gosha ba chap beraud.

items.dari: بازار از خانه ما دورتر است.
items.en: The market is farther than our house.
items.translit: Bāzār az khāna-ye mā dortar ast.

items.en: The school is closer than the market.

items.dari: این موتر از آن موتر بزرگ‌تر است.
items.en: This car is bigger than that car.
items.translit: In motar az ān motar bozorgtar ast.

items.dari: برادر من از من بلندتر است.
items.en: My brother is taller than me.
items.translit: Barādar-e man az man boland-tar ast.

items.dari: این خانه از آن خانه ارزان‌تر است.
items.en: This house is cheaper than that house.
items.translit: In khāna az ān khāna arzāntar ast.

items.en: Which book is better?

items.dari: این کارها از آن کار بدتر است.
items.en: This work is worse than that work.
items.translit: In kār az ān kār badtar ast.

items.en: He/She is the biggest student in the class.

items.dari: آخر هفته من با دوستان خود بازی کردم.
items.en: On the weekend I played with my friends.
items.translit: Ākher-e hafta man bā dostān-e khod bāzi kardam.

items.en: We went to the park.
My sister read many books.

items.dari: پدر و مادر من در خانه ماندند.
items.en: My father and mother stayed home.
items.translit: Pedar wa mādar-e man dar khāna māndand.

items.en: What did you do on Saturday?

items.dari: من هیچ کار نکردم، فقط استراحت کردم.
items.en: I did nothing, I just rested.
items.translit: Man hich kār nakardam, faqat esterāhat kardam.

items.dari: امروز من به مکتب می‌روم، دیروز هم رفتم.
items.en: Today I go to school, yesterday too I went.
items.translit: Emroz man ba maktab miraum, diroz ham raftam.

items.dari: حالا او کار می‌کند، دیروز هم کار کرد.
items.en: Now he/she works, yesterday too he/she worked.
items.translit: Hālā u kār mikonad, diroz ham kār kard.

items.dari: پارسال ما در کابل بودیم، امسال در هرات هستیم.
items.en: Last year we were in Kabul, this year we are in Herat.
items.translit: Pārsāl mā dar Kābul budim, emsāl dar Herāt hastim.

items.dari: این کتاب‌ها از کتاب‌های پارسال بهتر است.
items.en: These books are better than last year's books.
items.translit: In kitāb-hā az kitāb-hā-ye pārsāl behtar ast.

items.dari: او دیروز مریض بود، امروز صحت او خوب است.
items.en: He/She was sick yesterday, today his/her health is good.
items.translit: U diroz mariz bud, emroz sehat-e u khub ast.
